mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.is_deleted, u.id as buyer_id, u.username, p.id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.price,p.description,p.img_url, c.id as comment_id, c.content, c.comment_date FROM `order` o JOIN user u ON o.buyer_id = u.id JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON o.comment_id = c.id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT o.id, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.is_deleted, u.id as seller_id, u.username, p.id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.price,p.description,p.img_url, c.id as comment_id, c.content, c.comment_date FROM `order` o JOIN user u ON o.seller_id = u.id JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON o.comment_id = c.id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT o.id, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.is_deleted, o.seller_id, u.username,u.id as buyer_id, p.id as product_id, p.product_name as product_name, p.price, p.description, p.img_url, c.id as comment_id, c.content, c.comment_date FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.buyer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON o.comment_id = c.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (buyer_id, seller_id, content, comment_date) VALUES (#{buyer_id}, #{seller_id}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.content, c.comment_date, c.buyer_id, c.seller_id FROM comment c JOIN `order` o ON o.comment_id = c.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (buyer_id, seller_id, product_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{user.id}, #{seller_id}, #{product.id}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
